# CANDIDATE: ORB_VOLUME_SKEW_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Early session volume imbalance predicts continuation when price returns to VWAP. If buying volume exceeds selling volume by 1.5x in the first 30 minutes AND price closes near VWAP, institutional acceptance of the imbalance suggests trend continuation. This edge exists because volume precedes price, and VWAP return indicates fair value acceptance after directional initiation.

## Mechanism

Entry: At 10:00 ET close (30-minute OR bar), if:
- Buy-side volume (sum of volume where close > open) > 1.5 × sell-side volume (sum of volume where close < open)
- |30-min close - VWAP_30min| / VWAP_30min ≤ 0.001
Then enter long at the 30-min bar close.

Exit:
- Stop: OR low (low of first 30-min bar)
- TP1: 1.5R (R = entry - stop)
- Runner: trail 15% off HWM after TP1 hit
- Time filter: only trades between 09:30-10:30 ET; avoid if VIX > 25; prefer VIX < 20

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L (scales linearly with contracts).
2. **Sample bias:** Zero historical samples tested; proposal based solely on mechanistic hypothesis. Extreme overfit risk until validated.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no OOS test performed)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no real-fills validation on top 3 J days)
5. **Failure modes:**
   - Worst day: triggering on false volume skew in choppy market, hitting OR low stop (-1R per contract)
   - Max drawdown: consecutive losses in low-VOL regimes where volume skew fails to predict direction
   - Blow-up: gap open beyond OR low on high-VIX day (e.g., FOMC) causing slippage worse than simulated stop
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (no data to compute top-5 days contribution)
